1
Ghurbat Ki Sham Sheh Ka Bhara Ghar Nahi Raha.
Chadar Nahi Rahi Tu Kahin Sar Nahi Raha.
Jhola Ke Gird Baitha Hai Chup Chap Ghar Ka Ghar.
Jhola Jhulaney Walon Ka Asghar Nahi Raha.

2
Gonji Sada Jo Shah Ki Sughra Ujar Gayi.
Sab Ko Khabar Yeh Ho Gayi Akbar Nahi Raha.
Sab Lasha-e-Hussain Pe Barsa Chukay Laeen.
Ab In Ke Pas Aik Bhi Pathar Nahi Raha.

3
Tanha Pidar Ko Dhondne Maqtal Mein Aa Gayi.
Masooma Ko Kissi Ka Bhi Ab Dar Nahi Raha.
Jaisay Gayi Thi Waisay Hi Saqlain Aa Gayi.
Ik Bond Pani Mashk Ke Andar Nahi Raha.

from pathlib import Path
import subprocess, sys
path = sys.argv[1]
original = subprocess.check_output(['git', 'show', f'HEAD:{path}'], text=True).split('\\n---\\n')[1]
header, body = Path(path).read_text().split('\\n---\\n')
roman = header.split('romanLyrics: |-\\n')[1]
blocks = lambda value: [block.splitlines() for block in value.strip().split('\\n\\n')]
old, new, urdu = map(blocks, (original, '\\n'.join(line.strip() for line in roman.splitlines()), body))
assert [[line.lower().rstrip('.') for line in block] for block in old] == [[line.lower() for line in block] for block in new]
assert [len(block) for block in urdu] == [5, 5, 5]
assert [block[0] for block in urdu] == list('۱۲۳')
print('Verified unchanged Roman wording and three matching four-verse stanzas.')
PY"

item.text:
Reconstructed all 12 verses in Urdu script and verified that the Urdu and Roman editions each contain three four-verse stanzas. Preserved the Roman wording in `romanLyrics`, set the direction to right-to-left, and removed the `noUrdu` tag.

Rendered “Sheh” as `شہ` and kept “Jhola ke gird” as `جھولا کے گرد` to preserve the supplied reading.
